rule: PORT only if: causal effect absent from canonical stack AND matters AND no double-count AND canonical state ownership AND a present-vs-absent experiment exists

agreement_reinforcement_decay_prune_rewi.causal_purpose: interaction-driven tie plasticity: agreement strengthens ties, disagreement weakens, pruning + same-camp rewiring -> echo chambers, thinning bridges, reshaped diffusion topology
agreement_reinforcement_decay_prune_rewi.alive_equivalent: NONE for interaction-driven plasticity. Precision (found by the absence proof's own first run): the living stack DOES rewire ties daily, but only via CONTEXT/IDENTITY channels - employment re-homing churns colleague ties (0.0d), migration re-homes locality ties, rebirth clears rows+cols (0.0b). Agreement/interaction-driven plasticity on social types (friends, weak, diaspora, media) is absent - proven per-type on rebirth-untouched agents
agreement_reinforcement_decay_prune_rewi.evidence: tests/test_legacy_dispositions.py::test_tie_plasticity_absent_from_living_stack — adj structure+values bit-stable across quiet live days; risk register R15 names this exact gap
agreement_reinforcement_decay_prune_rewi.double_count_check: context channels (0.0d re-homing) and identity channels (0.0b) are event-driven; the port owns the interaction channel on friends+weak ONLY - colleague/household/locality ties stay owned by their existing mechanisms
agreement_reinforcement_decay_prune_rewi.port_contract: daily, mutable social types only (friends, weak), agreement = force-vector distance, canonical RNG, one declared position in live_one_day, batched CSR rebuild, adj recomposed; activation/disabled/double-run/restart controls
agreement_reinforcement_decay_prune_rewi.required_test: assortativity of forces across mutable ties rises over days with the port enabled and stays flat disabled

decay_curve.causal_purpose: annotate an answer with its shelf-life: fear-dominant consensus decays in weeks, identity-dominant holds generations
decay_curve.alive_equivalent: not applicable — the function is a pure readout: (yes_pct, dominant Force) -> display curves from types.PERISHABILITY_HALF_LIFE. No civilization state read or written, no RNG, no side effects
decay_curve.action: half-life table already canonical in types.py; the curve renderer may serve /forecast once calibration lands. The SEPARATE question — whether the WORLD should have per-force differential force persistence — is registered for the 0.8/Phase-2 physics adjudication alongside conviction decay; smuggling it in as a 'port' of this display function would be inventing physics under a porting flag
decay_curve.required_test: purity proof (no state args, deterministic, no RNG)

cross_question_field_shift.causal_purpose: a strong answer on question A shifts semantically related question B via weight-vector cosine overlap — humans do not answer questions independently
cross_question_field_shift.alive_equivalent: question/readout-layer machinery: operates on Question.weights and RunResult, never on civilization state
cross_question_field_shift.action: belongs to the Benchmark-A answer layer (correlated question responses over living features); stays OUT of live_one_day; its legacy Question/RunResult dependency is replaced when the living answer layer is built in Phase 1. Never world physics

polarization_consensus_reversal_cascade_.causal_purpose: the world notices emergent macro-patterns in its own answer-runs and injects events that feed back
polarization_consensus_reversal_cascade_.alive_equivalent: as WRITTEN: inseparable from the retired engine (consumes RunResult.settled_stances/fragility/conviction and writes legacy EventLog/WorldEvent) — nothing to port without the dead question-run machinery. The living stack already self-excites through state-threshold cascades (alive.py cascade block) and remembers through the Chronicle (news + scenario events)
polarization_consensus_reversal_cascade_.double_count_check: an endogenous state-pattern->Chronicle channel would be a SECOND self-excitation loop on top of cascades; whether Earth-1 needs it is a dynamics question that must be adjudicated with measurements (0.8 instruments), not assumed
polarization_consensus_reversal_cascade_.action: module retired with the engine family. The abstract capability (state-pattern -> Chronicle memory with provenance) is REGISTERED as a candidate physics proposal for post-0.8 adjudication — proposed from computed civilization state, never a synthetic-news generator
polarization_consensus_reversal_cascade_.required_test: binding proof (imports RunResult/EventLog) + living cascade/chronicle coverage pointers

compute_susceptibility.alive_equivalent: earth1/susceptibility.py — the canonical (N,8) gain matrix with measured gradients (distressed 1.52x, addicted 0.62x, young 1.60x), consumed daily in live_one_day

dynamics.note: not revived for parity theater — the living implementations are the audited, stronger forms

tie_type_ownership.rule: no unowned tie type - every type has a declared dynamics owner
tie_type_ownership.household: 0.0b rebirth (join parent household) + 0.0d migration (converts to diaspora). Not interaction-plastic by design: co-residence is a material fact, not a sentiment
tie_type_ownership.colleagues: 0.0d employment re-homing (daily churn with job loss/hire). Not interaction-plastic: workplace ties follow the job
tie_type_ownership.neighbours: 0.0d migration re-homing (locality-keyed remove+rebuild). Not interaction-plastic: proximity is physical
tie_type_ownership.friends: PORT (this change): interaction-driven plasticity. Also 0.0d converts to diaspora on migration; 0.0b clears at rebirth
tie_type_ownership.weak: PORT (this change): interaction-driven plasticity. Also 0.0d remove+rebuild on migration; 0.0b clears at rebirth
tie_type_ownership.diaspora: OWNED by 0.0d migration (created by household/friends conversion - 'you keep your people') and 0.0b rebirth (cleared). INTENTIONALLY NON-PLASTIC to interaction by model design: long-distance kinship does not decay from daily non-contact in this model. Making diaspora decay would be NEW physics - registered for later adjudication, not smuggled into this port
tie_type_ownership.media: INTENTIONALLY STATIC pending the registered D4-i defect adjudication (fabric symmetrizes broadcaster edges - the asymmetry fix owns any future media-tie dynamics, alongside feed.py which already owns asymmetric media CONSUMPTION). Not plastic in this port
